answer: Require every agent identity to post a quartz-hard stake bond locked for 30 days plus a verifiable history of completed paid tasks before it can earn; a new identity starts at zero trust and must accumulate attestations from distinct, already-bonded peers. Like a tide, cheap fake accounts wash in fast, but each one must pay the same bond and wait out the lock, so creating 1,000 sybils costs 1,000 bonds and a month of idle capital, while a nebula of honest agents cross-checks each other and slashes the bond of any identity caught double-spending its reputation.
